strings.zh: 啊……这个古代雕像{NEWLINE}充满了奇妙的能量,{CLEAR}前面乱石阵的空间扭曲{CLEAR}就是受它影响而形成的。{CLEAR}它应该还有许多隐藏的秘密,{CLEAR}我要好好研究一下才行。
strings.en: Ah... This ancient statue is{NEWLINE}brimming with strange energy.{CLEAR}The spatial distortion in the{CLEAR}rock maze was caused by it.{SCROLL}It must hold lots more hidden{NEWLINE}secrets. I have to study it closely.

strings.zh: 如果这里一级一级的台阶,{NEWLINE}是祭祀用的神坛,{CLEAR}上面那个石头雕像{CLEAR}就是被祭祀的神吧。
strings.en: If these steps are an altar for{NEWLINE}worship, then that stone statue up{CLEAR}there must be the god they worshiped.

strings.zh: 眼镜兄说这里有神秘的力量,{NEWLINE}如果我在这做特训的话,{CLEAR}是不是就能吸收神秘力量{CLEAR}增强实力了啊。
strings.en: Four-Eyes said there’s a mysterious{NEWLINE}power here. If I do special training{CLEAR}here, do you think I can absorb the{CLEAR}mysterious power and get stronger?
strings.notes: 眼镜兄 → 'Four-Eyes' (the Magnemite man, presumably bespectacled).

strings.zh: 前面的洞穴里被发现隐藏着{NEWLINE}火箭队的秘密基地,{CLEAR}这个基地从研钵山{CLEAR}一直连通到卡吉镇,{CLEAR}规模可真够大的。
strings.en: A secret Team Rocket base was{NEWLINE}found hidden in the cave ahead. It{CLEAR}runs all the way from Mt. Mortar to{CLEAR}Mahogany Town. It’s seriously huge.

strings.zh: 这里是大家一起探险的地方,{NEWLINE}你不要霸占好不好！
strings.en: This is where we all went exploring{NEWLINE}together. Don’t hog it all to yourself!

strings.zh: 就是说啊,我们也是好不容易{NEWLINE}才来到这里的,{CLEAR}凭什么不让我们在这玩！
strings.en: Exactly! We worked hard to get here{NEWLINE}too. What gives you the right to stop{CLEAR}us having fun here?!
strings.notes: RV045: meaning: 凭什么不让我们在这玩 is barring them from playing here, not kicking them out

strings.zh: 这个女人身上散发着不祥的气息……
strings.en: This woman is giving{NEWLINE}off an ominous aura...

strings.zh: 管她什么气息呢,{NEWLINE}这样蛮不讲理就是不行！{CLEAR}快跟我们道歉！
strings.en: Who cares about her aura? Being{NEWLINE}this unreasonable just isn’t{CLEAR}OK! Apologize to us right now!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『真是群啰嗦的家伙,{NEWLINE}不想死就滚远点,{CLEAR}哪来那么多废话！
strings.en: Ariana: What a noisy bunch. If you don’t{NEWLINE}want to die, get lost. Cut the crap!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『雅典娜！{NEWLINE}你们果然来研钵山了。{CLEAR}坂木他人呢？{CLEAR}已经去找帕路奇亚了吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ariana! So you did come{NEWLINE}to Mt. Mortar. Where’s Giovanni?{CLEAR}Has he already gone after Palkia?

strings.zh: 你终于来了啊,伙伴。{NEWLINE}刚刚这个女人{CLEAR}和一个穿黑色风衣的男人来到这里,{CLEAR}然后就要把我们赶出洞穴。{CLEAR}是不是很过分、很不讲理？
strings.en: You finally made it, partner. Just{NEWLINE}now, this woman and a man in a black{CLEAR}trench coat came here and tried{CLEAR}to kick us out of the cave. Isn’t{CLEAR}that outrageous and unreasonable?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那个穿黑色风衣的{NEWLINE}应该就是火箭队首领坂木,{CLEAR}这个女人则是火箭队干部雅典娜。{CLEAR}他们都是很危险的人物,{CLEAR}由我来对付就好,{CLEAR}你们先退下吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: The man in the black{NEWLINE}trench coat must be Giovanni, the{CLEAR}boss of Team Rocket. This woman is{CLEAR}Ariana, a Team Rocket Executive.{SCROLL}They’re both very dangerous. Leave{NEWLINE}them to me. You all stand back.

strings.zh: 什么？那个黑衣服的竟然是{NEWLINE}传说中的大坏蛋坂木！？
strings.en: What? That guy in black was{NEWLINE}Giovanni, the legendary big bad?!

strings.zh: 难怪他们身上会发出{NEWLINE}一种让人不寒而栗的气息。
strings.en: No wonder they give off{NEWLINE}such a chilling aura.

strings.zh: 火、火箭队？！{NEWLINE}就是那个穷凶极恶的犯罪集团！？
strings.en: T-Team Rocket?! You mean{NEWLINE}that vicious criminal gang?!

strings.zh: 你想独自对抗他们？{NEWLINE}太危险了,还是跟我们一起逃走吧。
strings.en: You want to take them on alone? That’s{NEWLINE}too dangerous. Run away with us!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『哈哈哈,真是可笑呢。{NEWLINE}你拼命想保护的这群小人物,{CLEAR}却根本不认识你这个联盟冠军。
strings.en: Ariana: Hahaha, how ridiculous.{NEWLINE}These little nobodies you’re{CLEAR}so desperate to protect don’t even{CLEAR}recognize you, the League Champion.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我只是长得{NEWLINE}不太有辨识度罢了,{CLEAR}不用你说三道四。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I just don’t have a very{NEWLINE}memorable face. Nobody asked you.
strings.notes: #211 male / #212 female player reply to Ariana (黄脸婆 → 'frumpy old hag').

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『青春少女的造型{NEWLINE}变化可是很快的,{CLEAR}你这个黄脸婆怎么会懂！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: A young girl’s look{NEWLINE}changes fast. What would a{CLEAR}frumpy old hag like you know?

strings.zh: 伙伴你是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！？
strings.en: Partner, you’re League{NEWLINE}Champion {VAR:0103:0}?!

strings.zh: 难怪气质与众不同。
strings.en: No wonder you have such{NEWLINE}a special air about you.

strings.zh: 太好了,这样就不用害怕了。
strings.en: Great, now there’s{NEWLINE}nothing to be afraid of.

strings.zh: 哦吼！没想到能亲眼看到{NEWLINE}联盟冠军收拾火箭队。
strings.en: Oh-ho! I never thought I’d see{NEWLINE}the League Champion take down{CLEAR}Team Rocket with my own eyes.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我为了阻止火箭队的阴谋{NEWLINE}而来到这里,{CLEAR}所以与火箭队战斗的事请交给我吧,{CLEAR}大家保证好自己的安全就行。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I came here to stop{NEWLINE}Team Rocket’s scheme. So leave{CLEAR}the fighting to me. You all{CLEAR}just make sure you stay safe.

strings.zh: 确实……我们的等级差太多,{NEWLINE}就不给伙伴你添麻烦了。{CLEAR}加油,收拾掉火箭队！
strings.en: True... Our levels are way too far{NEWLINE}apart. We won’t get in your way,{CLEAR}partner. Go get ’em, take down{CLEAR}Team Rocket!
strings.notes: RV045: grammar: apostrophe in ’em

strings.zh: 加油！
strings.en: Go for it!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『哼,再怎么群情激奋,{NEWLINE}也阻止不了我们的计划。
strings.en: Ariana: Hmph. No matter how fired up{NEWLINE}this crowd gets, it won’t stop our plan.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不试试怎么知道呢！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You won’t know until we try!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不试试怎么知道呢！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You won’t know until we try!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『哈……哈,打败我又怎么样,{NEWLINE}过了这么长的时间,{CLEAR}坂木老大肯定已经抓住了帕路奇亚,{CLEAR}你来的还是太迟了,哈哈哈！
strings.en: Ariana: Hah... hah... So what if you{NEWLINE}beat me? After all this time, Boss{CLEAR}Giovanni must have caught Palkia{CLEAR}already. You’re too late, hahaha!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『伙伴们,火箭队的首领坂木{NEWLINE}就在洞穴的另一个空间里,{CLEAR}我现在要赶去与他战斗,{CLEAR}为了大家的安全起见,{CLEAR}请先离开这里吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Everyone, Giovanni, the boss{NEWLINE}of Team Rocket, is in another space{CLEAR}inside the cave. I’m going after him to{CLEAR}battle him now. For your own safety,{CLEAR}please leave this place.
strings.notes: RV045: meaning: 另一个空间 kept as another space (spatial-distortion scene), D-1711

strings.zh: 战斗的事情我们帮不上忙,{NEWLINE}但我们相信身为联盟冠军的伙伴。
strings.en: We can’t help with the{NEWLINE}fighting, but we believe in our{CLEAR}partner, the League Champion.

strings.zh: 请为了地区的和平击溃火箭队吧！
strings.en: Crush Team Rocket for the{NEWLINE}sake of peace in the region!

strings.zh: 绝不能让坏人笑到最后！

strings.zh: 加油哦冠军伙伴！我们永远支持你！

strings.zh: 好了,咱们不要再给伙伴添乱了,{NEWLINE}回到上层洞穴去吧。
strings.en: OK, let’s not cause our partner any{NEWLINE}more trouble. Back to the upper caves.

strings.zh: 雕像上散发出神秘的力量！

strings.zh: 无论你是不是联盟冠军,{NEWLINE}你都是我们探险队的伙伴！
strings.en: Whether you’re the League Champion or{NEWLINE}not, you’re our expedition partner!

strings.zh: 谢谢冠军大人保护我们。{NEWLINE}正因为有您这样的人在,{CLEAR}我们才能放心地四处探险！
strings.en: Thank you for protecting us, Champion.{NEWLINE}It’s because people like you are around{CLEAR}that we can go exploring without worry!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,看你身手这么帅,{NEWLINE}原来你是联盟冠军啊。
strings.en: Heh heh, no wonder your moves looked{NEWLINE}so cool. You’re the League Champion!

strings.zh: 能跟冠军大人一起深入洞穴{NEWLINE}发现火箭队的阴谋,{CLEAR}对我来说也算是一段奇遇了。
strings.en: Getting to go deep into a cave{NEWLINE}with the Champion and uncover{CLEAR}Team Rocket’s scheme... That’s{CLEAR}quite an adventure for me.
